commitResults.messageTitle: Configure agent guidance for local Java setup
Add task model for completion tracking
commitResults.messageBody:
Tasks need to retain their completion state so the chatbot can mark and unmark them reliably.

Store task descriptions and status in a dedicated Task class, and let Nga
operate on Task objects for list, mark, and unmark commands.

Keep task presentation and state changes with the task model to improve
encapsulation and support the required object-oriented design.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add project coding and Git skills
commitResults.messageBody:
The project needs reusable guidance for Java style and Git commit messages so future changes follow the SE Education conventions consistently.

Add project-specific skills that capture the required naming, layout,
encapsulation, documentation, commit subject, and commit body rules.

Keep the source links in each skill so the conventions remain traceable.

Future project changes need to follow the reusable Java and Git skills so coding and commit conventions are applied consistently.

Require agents to consult the project-specific Java standard for all Java
code and the Git standard when proposing or creating commits.

Keep the mandate in the repository instructions so it applies to future
work regardless of which task is being implemented.

commitResults.messageTitle: Migrate chatbot sources and add visual diff skill
commitResults.messageBody: Update the project documentation and move the chatbot implementation into its package. Add the visual change-presentation skill files so repository changes can be reviewed consistently.
Include the skill files in the project so repository changes can be presented in a self-contained visual diff.

Nga and NgaEnglish currently duplicate the logic that converts user commands into task objects. Keep that parsing behavior in one shared TaskParser so both entry points remain consistent and future command changes have one maintenance location.

Preserve the existing command formats and validation messages while reducing repeated logic in the chatbot classes. This follows the code-quality guidance to avoid unnecessary repetition and improves readability by keeping command-loop classes focused on interaction flow.

commitResults.messageTitle: Separate command handling from Nga UI
commitResults.messageBody: Move task storage into TaskList and isolate command parsing from console interaction. Validate empty task fields in the parser and return command results for the UI to display.
Support structured task commands, completion tracking, persistent storage, and task deletion. Document future requirements and UI checks for the project.

Require users to start generic tasks with the todo prefix and guide them to the help command when Nga receives an unknown command. Document and retain the Level 7 task-management and executable-JAR updates in the same project change.

Check task details before adding a task and report the existing one-based index when a duplicate is found. This keeps the task list free of repeated todos, deadlines, and events while preserving the original task.
Explain that the executable JAR must be rebuilt after Java source changes so users run the latest application code.
Explain that NGA stands for No Goobers Allowed in the project documentation and user-facing startup messages so reviewers and users understand the name.

Make Nga own the user interface and command handler so the entry point acts as the application coordinator. Reuse that composition from the English entry point and move future behavior changes toward focused classes.

Introduce the abstract Command contract and move exit behavior into ExitCommand. Keep command dispatch behavior unchanged while creating a foundation for extracting the remaining command cases incrementally.

commitResults.messageTitle: Teach deadlines to understand date times
commitResults.messageBody: Store deadline values as LocalDateTime objects and accept ISO dates, ISO date-times, and day-month-year input with compact times. Format deadlines for people when displaying them and persist them in a reloadable ISO representation.
Allow users to find tasks by matching a case-insensitive keyword in the description. Document the new command so users can discover and use it.

commitResults.messageTitle: Document Java APIs and reject delimiters
commitResults.messageBody: Add JavaDoc for the application classes, methods, records, and storage helpers. Reject the pipe delimiter in task input so saved tasks remain readable after restart.
Explain that commands must use spaces as delimiters and list every supported deadline date format when parsing fails.
Keep the help command aligned with the supported deadline formats and explain the space and delimiter restrictions users must follow.

Report how many malformed task rows were skipped during startup while continuing to load valid tasks. Show the warning once so storage problems are visible without interrupting normal command handling.
Align the Gradle toolchain, project instructions, README build steps, and UI test plan with the required Java 25 environment.
Document the Java 25 IntelliJ setup, clean Shadow JAR build, and project-root requirement for locating data/nga.txt.
Document the chatbot commands, task types, deadline formats, persistence behavior, and input rules so users can operate NGA without relying on the source code.
Publish NGA user guide
